offerAvailable.body: Dobrý deň {{firstName}}, ponuka financovania {{reference}} je dostupná v zabezpečenej zóne.
offerAvailable.details: Your offer details the amount, term, annual rate, instalment, total cost and fees. It remains valid until the date shown in your secure area.

contractSent.subject: Vaša zmluva {{reference}} je pripravená
contractSent.body: Dobrý deň {{firstName}}, zmluva {{reference}} je pripravená na podpis v zabezpečenej zóne.
contractSent.details: Your financing contract is available online. Read it in full, download the PDF, then sign it electronically with a one-time code sent by email. The signature is timestamped and archived.

disbursed.subject: Prostriedky vyplatené — spis {{reference}}
disbursed.body: Dobrý deň {{firstName}}, prostriedky spisu {{reference}} boli poukázané na váš účet.

contractSigned.subject: Zmluva {{reference}} podpísaná

contractSigned.details: Your signed contract is archived and downloadable at any time from your secure area, where the next steps (coverage, insurance, disbursement) are tracked in real time.

guaranteeDeclined.subject: Žiadosť {{reference}} zrušená

guaranteePayLater.subject: Platba naplánovaná {{reference}}
guaranteePayLater.body: Dobrý deň {{firstName}}, platba {{amount}} je naplánovaná na {{date}}. Žiadosť zostáva čakajúca.
guaranteePayLater.details: Your application stays reserved until the chosen date. You may bring the payment forward at any time from your secure area.

guaranteePaymentValidated.subject: Poplatok potvrdený {{reference}}
guaranteePaymentValidated.body: Dobrý deň {{firstName}}, platba bola potvrdená. Spis pokračuje.

insurancePending.details: Borrower insurance covers death, disability and job loss under the contract terms. Coverage, monthly premium and payment terms are detailed in your secure area.

insuranceValidated.subject: Poistenie potvrdené {{reference}}
insuranceValidated.body: Dobrý deň {{firstName}}, vaše poistenie bolo potvrdené.
